_source: Gercek cikti, 2026-11-27, Windows 11 Pro 26200, Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100 (tr-TR), normal kullanici, salt okuma. Seri numarasi ve MAC alinmadi; PCI ornek kimligi (son parca) ve arayuz GUID sifirlandi. text_values: Get-PhysicalDisk | Select-Object DeviceId,BusType,MediaType,HealthStatus | ConvertTo-Json (eski betigin gordugu metin degerler). script_disk / script_part: inventory_win.rs INVENTORY_SCRIPT'in disk ve part satirlari (Surum 11, CimInstanceProperties ham degerleri). gpu: Win32_VideoController Name,PNPDeviceID. plan: powercfg /getactivescheme. wear/temp normal kullanicida null (servis SYSTEM'de okur).
